Functions§

dist 🔒
Builds the sysroot for the host into <out-dir>/sysroot, with the solvers bundled, and packs it into <out-dir>/flux-<host>.tar.gz. The archive contains a top-level sysroot directory, so extracting it in the Flux home gives the default sysroot.
host_triple 🔒
The target triple of the host, as reported by the pinned rustc.
write_archive 🔒
Packs sysroot into the .tar.gz file archive, under a top-level sysroot directory.
